BL-717 — DEFECT — Bubble returns silent after hold music instead of speaking a reply
What it solves: Severity rationale: real and repeated, but contained to voice UX and the
human can retry the turn; nothing is lost or corrupted. Deliberately NOT
high — high would put it in the Article 3.2.4 expedite lane, which the human
ruled out for this one.
Approval context: Three defaults chosen without asking, cheap to amend: (1) the empty-content fallback is spoken, not merely shown on screen; (2) the bridge stops answering `success: true` when the agent produced empty reply text — it returns fallback speakable text or an explicit failure instead, so the phone is ne…
BL-717 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-717" (or "reject BL-717 <reason>") to act.
